summary: Aerolink advertises $5 in one-time testing credits for eligible new accounts after verification and abuse checks, valid for 30 days, with no recurring free plan. The offer text disappeared from the pricing and registration pages on 2026-10-24 reappeared on 2026-10-26, was absent again on 2026-10-27 and was back on 2026-10-28; confirm the credit in your dashboard before relying on it.
claim_steps: Generate an API key from the dashboard and point your client at the Aerolink base URL.

Check your account dashboard for the $5 testing credit before relying on it: the pricing and register pages have intermittently stopped advertising it (absent 2026-10-24/25 and 2026-10-27, shown again 2026-10-28). When granted, it is valid for 30 days.
